title: The Dark Truth About Hatred (video game) #Shorts
description:
Nothing in Hatred (video game) was built for you — it was built for reproduction. Hatred is an isometric shoot 'em up video game developed and published by Destructive Creations that was released on June 1, 2015, for Microsoft Windows. The character the player uses in the game is a misanthropic mass-killer referred to as "The Antagonist" or "Not Important", who begins a "genocide crusade" to kill as many human beings as possible.

Behind Hatred (video game) sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. Softpedia praised the game's mechanics, calling the game "a good twin-stick shooter that manages to offer an interesting experience only through the actual theme". IGN Italy praised the game's shooting mechanics and visuals component, but criticized its repetitiveness and poor artificial intelligence; likewise IGN Spain praised the game's visuals and scenario's destructibility but panned its A.I. and poor plot.
